name: roundabout guidance receptor 1
pathways: positive regulation of Rho protein signal transduction

function.text: ROBO1 encodes roundabout homolog 1. Annotated molecular activities include axon guidance receptor activity and LRR domain binding. It participates in positive regulation of Rho protein signal transduction and aorta development.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to neurooculorenal syndrome (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
